architectureDirection: Viable: existing dedicated helper + staged ordinary policy + one existing multi-member trusted-local publisher; bounded current-binding sequence/high-water; queue correlation only; existing computer access. No second journal or new service/UI is needed.

findings.scenario: The proposed gm_prompt_delivery.json and gm_relay_apply_receipt.json live in game_state/control. Both current snapshot producers include them by default. A client turn rollback deletes newly created tracked paths or restores their earlier images before a lost ACK/daemon restart/repair reconciliation.
findings.consequence: Durable operational dispatch or committed application evidence can disappear or rewind independently of relay acknowledgement. The design then cannot guarantee continuing ordinary/repair sessions without lost correspondence or unsupported replay inference. Missing evidence must remain blocked, never interpreted as a fresh submit or rollback proof. This is a confirmed integration gap in proposed paths, not an executed runtime failure.
findings.minimumCorrection: Amend the existing plan/inventory with explicit operational lifetime/ownership for these two exact paths. Preserve them across ordinary game rollback and snapshot preparation by narrowly excluding them, or choose an equivalently safe already-authorized location with same-commit receipt publication. Define bounded replacement/retirement under original request+generation authority; no blanket control-directory exemption, old-run authority, new journal, or gameplay-policy change. Pin actual engine snapshot/restore, live preparation and daemon reader dependencies.
requiredTests: Current real snapshot/rollback deletes/restores ordinary neighbor while retaining exact new operational records.
Committed response followed by rejected-turn rollback/repair and lost ACK still reconciles read-only; receipt absence never authorizes replay.
Same-live-binding daemon restart queries the original dispatch after rollback; changed/closed generation or request cannot reuse it.
findings.gate: Narrow metadata architecture amendment and exact dependency readback before G1 TDD release; targeted A01 closure review only, no full audit restart.

mandatoryLaterGates.requirement: Single dedicated-helper lease; all original physical read/kind/tree/witnesses rechecked independently from staged read view; exact ordinary normalization/policy and terminal checks retained; receipt is client-authored and denied to packet Writes/FilesModified. Hold real publication cuts including third member, terminal-before-commit, committed cleanup debt and lost ACK. Actual daemon AND current client reader must wait for recovery/complete decision; never raw-file existence. Terminal remains logically last; publisher unchanged.

Freeze sequence/body before dispatch; same-sequence proven NotReady retry retains original identity. Handle concurrent direct producers/gap refusal, duplicate/conflict within and beyond compact window, expired-query no repaste, same-binding restart, new-binding stale evidence, late Stop and completed-task/CTS disposal only after settlement. Two live operations remain bounded; permanently closed queue never reopens.

mandatoryLaterGates.stage: concrete SOURCE/PREP resource qualification then EVIDENCE
mandatoryLaterGates.requirement: 4/16/64/256MiB and8MiB logs are proposed, not accepted measurements. Account for original target before-images, after-images, parser/object/base64 copies, journal/scratch and temporary publications, unresolved winner disk plus logs and descriptor windows. Admit/refuse before oversized buffering/mutation; quota cannot discard unresolved authority. Preserve32KiBchunks/64KiBcontrol frames and bounded parallelism. Real packet evidence remains separately labelled from synthetic >1MiB/>32writes growth.

Current bridge normalizes CRLF/CR and neutral TerminalScreen limits128rows/65536columns and trims final newlines. Explicitly prove exact neutral prompt bytes/hash including newline endings, tabs/Unicode, long multiline and long single-line packets; no silent normalization. Do not widen Mini/editor semantics or use a truncated diagnostic tail as exact proof.

current-request descriptor is an optional stable locator over the existing queue, not a mandatory new file UI/tool/access method. Document operator startup separately. Actual agent read/write capability must read exact current request and relevant instructions/state, author and publish a correlated winner; Python worker fixture alone cannot qualify SC004. Partial response/reply publication must retain one winner without reinterpretation or unbounded retries.

Select actual changed owner methods plus narrow rollback/read/receipt controls and positive ordinary helper neighbors. Twelve submissions/four repair cycles and >256 retention control must bind current original owners and complete exact payloads; transport/helper/terminal/daemon trajectory accepted is not client story/history acceptance. Observe actual client result separately. Fresh native discovery counts remain unknown at ARCH. Linux and nativeWindows remain separate; unavailable Windows is open, no CI/artifact workaround; no unchanged1558/A255/B78 replay.

nextAllowedWork: Root may authorize only the narrow plan/inventory A01 amendment and added-dependency readback. After targeted closure and persisted ARCH acceptance, G1 tests-only may proceed; actual runs and implementation remain separate gates. No routine user technical approval is needed.
